Results.ReviewText:
I would normally write a 5 star awesome! review - but for one thing.  Unfortunately, I can't even say "one small thing".  For all the quality features, set up, directions, support resources, and the amount of money invested in this grill, you would think that the set of wheels on one end would have a handle of some sort od handle or bar on the other to allow one to use the wheels easily!   This grill is very heavy for a single little old lady, especially with the propane tank in place.  If Weber went to the trouble of putting wheels on it (to make it EASY to move around the patio??), could they not have designed a sturdy handle on the other end?  The left table extension is not really attached for moving the grill and the rest of the frame is sharp to lift
 the whole thing.  Very poor call, Weber --
Results.Title: Why bother with the wheels?

Results.ReviewText: It's a decent grill, cooks evenly just not the quality I expect from Weber. It's just my wife and I now but we cook outside 3 to 4 times a week year round, we need a high quality grill to stand up to that much use. But it just being 2 of us now we don't need a 4 burner or larger, which seems like what you want me to buy to get a sturdy long lasting grill. I bought a Weber because my Genesis Silver was a sturdy well built grill and lasted us many years. I'm not happy with how flimsy this one is in comparison. It cooks good, but I don't see it lasting nearly as long as my last one did. I researched looking at other brands for a small high quality grill, nobody makes one. Its like all of you think someone wants a small grill because they're cheap or poor. You won by default because you were the least flimsy at this size point, not exactly a stellar win. If another manufacturer came along and made a better small grill, I'd buy it.
Results.Title: Not really worthy of the Weber name

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you are having trouble getting your grill up to high temperature. We are here to help! 

First, complete the soapy water leak test outlined in your owner's guide to rule out a gas leak.

1.) Please make sure you consider "High" on your control knobs to be the first spot to your left (the 9:00 position). The further you go to the right the lower the temperature will be and all the way to the right is low.

2.) Please make sure you're always cooking with the lid down except when flipping the food halfway. The second you open the lid the heat escapes, and you'll need to close it to let the temperature recover.

3.) It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.


Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on all remaining burners
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 500-550°F

If troubleshooting doesn't resolve the issue, we're here to help! Please look for an email from our Support team soon. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
